summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 new features on /plan (PlanTakeoff): (1) Convert polygon measurement to room, (2) Deduct measurement from containing room (trémie/escalier), (3) XLSX export of métré. All three features WORK end-to-end via the UI: correct toasts fire, backend state updates, canvas + panel reflect changes, and the Excel file is downloaded successfully.

test_setup.user_used: pro@construpilot.fr / Pro2026! (tier pro_business — required because /plan is gated behind Pro Business paywall via BillingContext FEATURE_TIER.plan_takeoff = PRO_BUSINESS_ONLY)
test_setup.seed: Two polygon measurements created via POST /api/takeoffs/{id}/measure : (a) 'test convert' at [[800,800],[900,800],[900,900],[800,900]] (outside room), (b) 'test deduct' at [[100,100],[200,100],[200,200],[100,200]] (inside Salon).
test_setup.how_plan_opened: URL /plan?id=<pid> does NOT auto-open a plan (query param ignored). Had to click data-testid=recent-plan-<pid> on the landing gallery.

results.TEST_1_panel_and_measure_visible: PASS — data-testid='tool-objects-panel' opens data-testid='object-panel'. Measures tab lists both measurements with 1.00 m² badge.
results.TEST_2_convert_to_room: PASS — Click on data-testid='object-row-measure-0-extra' triggered toast 'Pièce créée : test convert (1 m²) — murs et volume calculés'. New room 'test convert' appears in the right-side rooms panel with Surface, Murs bruts, Murs nets, Volume computed. Backend GET /takeoffs shows rooms=2 (Salon + test convert).
results.TEST_3_deduct_from_room: PASS — After convert, measurements has only 'test deduct' at idx 0. Click on data-testid='object-row-measure-0-extra2' triggered toast '− 1 m² déduits de « Salon » → surface nette 23 m²'. Salon detail now shows the deduction chip '- 1 m² test deduct ×' allowing removal, and Surface updated 24→23 m². Backend confirms Salon.deductions has 1 entry.
results.TEST_4_xlsx_export: PASS — data-testid='plan-xlsx-export-btn' triggers download of metre-plan_619e41f98d6b.xlsx (6124 bytes, valid XLSX). Toast 'Export Excel téléchargé' displayed.
results.TEST_5_regression: PASS — /plan loads, canvas renders, Objets panel opens, tabs (Pièces/Mesures/Toitures/etc.) switch. No console errors observed during the flow.

observations.note: URL query param /plan?id=<pid> is NOT wired to auto-open a plan — user must click a recent-plan card. Consider parsing search param on mount for deep-linking.

Query for [data-testid^='object-row-room-'] returned 0 rows even though 2 rooms exist and are shown in the right-side Pièces column — the ObjectPanel rooms tab may not be populated from the same source or the testid prefix uses a different value than expected (room ids vs iteration index). Non-blocking as the main Pièces list works.

demo@construpilot.fr (billing tier='free' per /api/billing/me despite user.plan='premium') is BLOCKED from /plan by data-testid='plan-paywall'. Only pro_business users (or role=admin) can access /plan. This is by design per BillingContext but conflicts with the task instruction that said to use demo@construpilot.fr — flagging for review.

action_items: Verify intended access tier for /plan takeoff: task instruction assumed demo@ can use /plan but paywall blocks non-pro_business users. If demo should have access, grant demo a pro_business entitlement or lower FEATURE_TIER.plan_takeoff.
(Optional) Add search-param deep-linking on /plan?id=<pid> to auto-open a plan.
(Optional) Investigate ObjectPanel rooms tab testid population — rooms not queryable via object-row-room-* selectors even though rooms exist.
critical_code_review_comments: PlanTakeoff.jsx is 3142 lines — well above 700 line threshold; should be split into feature modules (canvas, panel logic, export, quote, snapshots).
BillingContext.has() defaults to true when feature not in FEATURE_TIER map (line 57) — safe default but worth documenting.
test_credentials: Used pro@construpilot.fr / Pro2026! (tier pro_business); demo@construpilot.fr is billing-free tier and blocked by paywall on /plan.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 polygon measurements on plan_619e41f98d6b (owned by pro user). Both were consumed by the tests (measurement→room, measurement→deduction). Backend measurements list is now empty for this plan.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Convert/deduct/xlsx flow validated end-to-end on pro user. If retesting with demo@, note the paywall gate (BillingContext plan_takeoff = pro_business_only). Use recent-plan-<pid> testid to open plans (query params not wired).
rca of the issue: No functional bugs found; only observations logged above.
